# Data dictionary

**File:** `data/raw/GramID_AST_digital_microscopy.csv`: 7,320 wells × 30 columns, 274 isolates, 8.0% of cells missing at random.
**Nature:** synthetic, generated by `src/data/generate_synthetic_data.py` (seed 42). It contains no real patients or isolates.
**Unit of observation:** one broth-microdilution well = one isolate × one antimicrobial × one two-fold concentration, imaged by digital microscopy.
**Loading:** `pd.read_csv(path, keep_default_na=False, na_values=[""])` keeps the valid Resistance_Marker value `"None"`.

| # | Column | Group | Type | Values / range | Meaning | Used by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Well_ID | ID | text | GP0001-VAN-01 … | Unique well | ID only |
| 2 | Isolate_ID | ID | text | GP0001 … GN0147 | Isolate (grouping key for splits and CV) | ID only |
| 3 | Organism | ID | text | 4 Gram-positive, 3 Gram-negative species | Reference identification | never a model input (would leak Gram) |
| 4 | Specimen_Source | Context | cat | Blood, Urine, Wound, Respiratory | Specimen type | candidate (dropped) |
| 5 | Antimicrobial | Panel | cat | Vancomycin, Ceftriaxone, Ampicillin, Oxacillin, Daptomycin, Meropenem | Drug in the well | Tier 2 |
| 6 | Concentration_ug_mL | Panel | num | 0.06–64 | Two-fold concentration | candidate (redundant with Well_DSI) |
| 7 | Well_DSI | Panel | int | 1–10 | Position of the well in its dilution series (1 = lowest) | Tier 2 |
| 8 | Crystal_Violet_Retention | Gram image | num | 0–1 | Crystal violet signal after decolourisation | Tier 1 |
| 9 | Safranin_Intensity | Gram image | num | 0–1 | Safranin counterstain signal | Tier 1 |
| 10 | Stain_Hue_Angle_deg | Gram image | num | ~260–352 | Mean hue (purple ≈ 280°, pink ≈ 330°) | Tier 1 |
| 11 | Cell_Wall_Thickness_nm | Gram image | num | 4–48 | Estimated wall thickness | Tier 1 |
| 12 | KOH_String_Test | ID test | cat | Positive / Negative | 3% KOH string test (Gram-negative positive) | Tier 1 |
| 13 | Cell_Morphology | Gram image | cat | Cocci_clusters, Cocci_pairs_chains, Rods | Image-classified morphology | Tier 1 |
| 14 | Catalase | ID test | cat | Positive / Negative | Catalase (staphylococci +, enterococci −) | Tier 1 |
| 15 | Resistance_Marker | Genotype | cat | None, mecA, vanA, vanB, blaCTX-M, blaKPC | Detected resistance gene | excluded from Tier 1 (leaks Gram) |
| 16 | Inoculum_log10_CFU_mL | AST QC | num | 5.3–6.1 | Inoculum density (target 5.7) | Tier 2 |
| 17 | Incubation_Time_h | AST QC | int | 18 or 24 | Read time (24 h for staph + vancomycin/oxacillin) | candidate (dropped) |
| 18 | Cell_Count_T0 | Growth image | num | 40–241 | Cells per field at time 0 | candidate (dropped) |
| 19 | Cell_Count_T4h | Growth image | num | 57–8,112 | Cells per field at 4 h | candidate (redundant with fold change) |
| 20 | Growth_Fold_Change | Growth image | num | 0.5–43 | T4h / T0 | Tier 2 |
| 21 | Mean_Cell_Area_um2 | Image | num | 0.4–5.9 | Mean cell area (filamentation raises it) | Tier 1, Tier 2 |
| 22 | Cell_Elongation_Index | Image | num | 1–11 | Length/width (rods, beta-lactam filaments) | Tier 1, Tier 2 |
| 23 | Occupied_Area_Fraction | Growth image | num | 0.005–0.95 | Share of the field covered by cells | Tier 2 |
| 24 | Time_to_Detection_h | Growth image | num | 1.5–24 | Time until growth detected (censored at incubation time) | Tier 2 |
| 25 | OD600_Read | Growth | num | 0.02–0.90 | Optical density at the read | Tier 2 |
| 26 | Growth_Control_OD600 | AST QC | num | 0.53–1.03 | OD of the drug-free growth control | candidate (dropped) |
| 27 | Gram_Reaction | **Target 1** | cat | Gram Positive 55% / Gram Negative 45% | Reference Gram reaction | Tier 1 label |
| 28 | Growth_Status | **Target 2** | cat | Growth 54.6% / No Growth 45.4% | Reference growth in this well | Tier 2 label |
| 29 | MIC_Call_ug_mL | **Target 3** | cat | 17 levels, e.g. `<=0.06`, `1`, `>64`; `Not_Applicable_GN` for Gram-negative | Reference MIC of the isolate-drug series | Tier 3 reference |
| 30 | MIC_DSI | **Target 3** | cat | 1–11; `Not_Applicable_GN` | MIC as a Dilution Series Index: 1 = at or below the lowest well, n+1 = above the highest | Tier 3 reference |

## Design rules built into the data
* A well grows **if and only if** its concentration is below the true MIC, so `MIC_DSI = number of growth wells + 1` in every Gram-positive series (checked by `validate`).
* About 10% of well images are **failed Gram reads**: all image Gram features look like a random organism. About 3% of wells carry a **growth-imaging artefact**: image growth features show the opposite state. ID tests are misread in 3–5% of wells.
* Missing cells (8% of the file) are completely at random and only in measured feature columns.
* The Gram-negative organisms (*E. coli*, *K. pneumoniae*, *P. aeruginosa*) are tested with ceftriaxone, ampicillin and meropenem. They contribute to Tiers 1 and 2 but have no MIC target.
